claims.text: DIC: FFP 15–30 mL/kg and cryoprecipitate to replace clotting factors
claims.quote: Likewise, fresh frozen plasma, typically at 15 mL/kg to 30 mL/kg, and cryoprecipitate can be transfused to replenish coagulation factors.

claims.text: PPH: TXA 1 g IV over 10 min if initial medical mgnt ineffective
claims.quote: Tranexamic acid can also be used if initial medical management is ineffective (1 g IV over 10 minutes).
